name: Watering the Field Trains Building
description: "Watering the field" now gives Building skill, but only when it makes progress towards the garden puzzle (after the lagoon puzzle is complete). Each watering that advances the garden ends with one ordinary Building practice roll, exactly like every other Building job; once the garden is restored, watering gives nothing extra. Because watering now trains Building, a villager whose job checkmark on the Villager Details screen is not Building (any other job, or none) waters the field only 14% of the times the game would send them to it; otherwise the game gives them its next choice of work instead. Villagers checked on Building water exactly as before, and your own drop on the field is never restricted. "Watering crops" and "Trying to water strange patch" are unchanged. **Runs on the Origins-exclusive base, which the patcher installs automatically with it**, so selecting this patch also adds the Origins Upgrades buttons to the Tech and Villager Details screens. That base's companion loads this patch's DLL; if the DLL cannot be loaded, the stock game runs unchanged.
behavior_changes: When a villager's "Watering the field" job reaches its garden progress step (0x43B1E6) while the garden is not yet restored, one practice-Building action (type 6, skill 4) is appended to the end of that villager's job -- the same action every stock Building job queues last, with the stock chance, amount and failure handling. The last watering that completes the garden counts.

Not checked on Building: the game sends a villager to water the field only from the work dispatcher's Building case (0x4472C0 case 4, the garden block 0x447635: garden not restored and progress above 0, then 0x43FC20), reached from the idle scheduler and the catch-up worker. The companion replaces the block's first twelve bytes: the same two tests, then, for a villager whose job preference (record +0x3D0) is not Building (4; 0 is no checkmark), one roll of its own (never the game's random numbers) that passes 14 times in 100 (NOT_PREFERRED_PERCENT). A failed roll continues at 0x44765E, where the stock block goes when the garden is not available: the Building branch's next choice, with watering excluded. A villager checked on Building is unchanged; the player's drops (0x4244A0, 0x424BAE) call 0x43FC20 directly and are never gated. The owner (2026-10-20).
explicit_non_changes: This row changes no executable bytes: the Origins companion loads the DLL, which detours 0x43B1E6 at run time only after verifying its twelve stock bytes; a different build of the game installs nothing.
The garden progress itself, its 200-step goal, the lagoon and well requirements, "Watering crops" (Farming) and "Trying to water strange patch" are unchanged.
Once the garden is restored, watering the field queues no extra practice action.

runtime_detours.routine: the work dispatcher's Building case, garden block (0x4472C0 case 4): watering the field for a villager not checked on Building only on 14 of 100 checks, else 0x44765E
